name: io.github.kioie/memex
title: memex
description: Long-term memory for AI coding agents — local MCP server for Cursor and Claude. Remember preferences and facts across chats; SQLite on your machine. Use stdio locally or self-host streamable HTTP for Smithery.

environmentVariables.name: MEMEX_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Data directory (default ~/.memex in native install; use /data in Docker)

environmentVariables.name: MEMEX_HYBRID
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable local vector retrieval fusion
